Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. Per our call, attaching the current listing copy and a proposed support routing diagram for the co-sell listing (RDW-marketplace-copy-v1.docx, support-routing-diagram.png). A couple of asks from the Marketplace team we want to pre-validate before formal submission: 

- Exact allowed phrasing for "24x7 support" vs "24/7 support" and whether we need to qualify with "for production incidents".
- Explicit SLA language they require for Sev1/Sev2 response times in the listing (they flagged: initial response time and phone escalation).
- Trademark/logo usage guidance for the co-sell badge — we used partner assets in the draft.
- Whether a dedicated support phone number is required for co-sell listings or if a routing rule to our centralized on-call (PagerDuty) is sufficient.

Internal next steps: Laura, can you confirm legal OK on the trademark snippet in section 2? Rishi, can you confirm that routing diagram maps to an existing PagerDuty escalation policy (we prefer to route via the umbrella PD service rather than publish a direct phone number). Marissa — can you review copy to ensure we don’t make any claims that would trigger additional review (e.g., SLA numerics tied to uptime)?

Sofia, if you can flag any language in the attached doc that will cause immediate rejection from AWS side, that would save cycles — we want to iterate once and send final package to aws-marketplace-reviews@amazon.com.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor

From: AWS Marketplace Reviews <aws-marketplace-reviews@amazon.com>

Subject: Re: Cloud channel portal copy + 24x7 support routing checklist

Thanks for the submission, Neha and Sofia. Quick notes from the reviews queue after a fast pass: 

1) "24x7" vs "24/7": we accept either but need the scope. Please include the phrase: "24x7 production incident response via ticketing and phone escalation" if you intend phone escalation. 

2) SLA language: Marketplace prefers conservative public-facing wording. Recommended public copy: 
   - "Initial response for Severity 1 (production down) incidents: within 1 hour during support hours.
   - Severity 2 (degraded production) initial response: within 4 hours."
   If you intend true 24x7 coverage for Sev1, we need: a documented on-call phone number and an internal runbook demonstrating 24x7 staffing. Otherwise mark Sev1 as "business hours" only.

3) Phone number requirement: a dedicated phone number is not strictly required for co-sell but is strongly recommended if you advertise 24x7 phone support. A routing rule to PagerDuty is acceptable if the listing provides the PagerDuty routing endpoint and a published escalation procedure (Drive link).

4) Trademark/logo: do not use the AWS logo unless you have explicit AWS partner marketing assets signed off. Use the "AWS Partner" badge text per the partner kit rather than a raw logo file.

5) Claims checklist: please remove any absolute claims like "guaranteed <10ms inference" unless you provide a publicly accessible benchmark report and the workload footprint (model + seq len).

If you can provide an updated copy with the suggested wording and the Drive runbook link, we'll expedite the final review. Note: we will also request a sample support case flow that shows the PagerDuty escalation mapping to a responder within 1 hour if you claim 24x7 Sev1.

— AWS Marketplace Reviews Team
aws-marketplace-reviews@amazon.com
